name: wet_air_cooled_condenser
title: Wet air-cooled condenser (spray evaporative cooling)
summary: Air-cooled condenser operating in wet regime (spray evaporation): air side treated as a fictitious dry fluid on wet-bulb temperatures with an effectiveness-NTU closure; given the duty and the air inlet/outlet states, determines AU_f, the fictitious capacity rate, the air flow rate and the spray/condensate water flow.

origin.course: Machines et systèmes thermiques (ULiège), repetition 5, exercise 3

verification.reference: Solution stored in the original EES file (15 variables with stored values); the values stated in the original comments (M_dot_a = 0.7398 kg/s, C_dot_a_f = 3322 W/K, NTU_f = 0.532) match the EES last-solution guesses
verification.notes: 15/15 common variables, 0 differ (rtol=0.001); max rel diff 7.4e-4 on w_ex (CoolProp humid-air formulation vs EES psychrometrics). Inputs and all stored variables agree. No unit conversion needed (SI-C-Pa-J).

related_external: CoolSolve examples/condenser_wet.eescode (verbatim transcription of the original, kept in CoolSolve as a test case)
